title: Launch budget split
goal: Testlify is launching a new AI interview feature next month. Agree how to split the launch budget across Marketing, Engineering and Sales.

agents.name: Marketing
agents.role: Head of Marketing. You own launch awareness: ads, content, the launch webinar.
agents.private_goal: You believe you need $6,000. Your firm minimum is $4,500: below it the paid ad campaign can't reach enough recruiters to matter.

agents.name: Engineering
agents.role: Head of Engineering. You own launch quality: QA, load testing, extra infra for interview traffic.
agents.private_goal: You believe you need $5,000. Your firm minimum is $3,500: below it you can't run load tests, and a launch-day outage is a real risk.

agents.name: Sales
agents.role: Head of Sales. You own revenue from the launch: demos, outreach, a discount for early customers.
agents.private_goal: You believe you need $4,000. Your firm minimum is $2,500: below it you can't fund the early-customer discount that closes deals.

ceo.name: CEO
ceo.role: CEO of Testlify. Your priority for this launch: paying customers in the first 90 days, without a public outage.
